newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain official rate to end 1997 at 4.5 pct - BCH.
newsitem.headline: Spain official rate to end 1997 at 4.5 pct - BCH.

text.p: Spanish bank Banco Central Hispano (BCH) said on Tuesday that it expects the official interest rate to end 1997 at around 4.5 percent, while the 10-year spread should end the year below 50 basis points.
"The official rate could end the year at around 4.5 percent, while the (10-year) spread over Bunds could end below 50 basis points," BCH wrote in a market commentary.
At 1420 GMT the Spanish 10-year spread over Bunds was trading at 63 basis points. It hit a record low at 60 basis points on June 19.
Earlier on Tuesday, the Bank of Spain left its key money market rate unchanged at 5.25 percent, disappointing some dealers who had expected the fifth cut in the year.

BCH's note added that it is likely the central bank will wait until October for its next move and also said the Bank of Spain would continue its monetary easing only if the 1998 budget "continues the advances made so far in the reduction of the public deficit".
